messages:
Samir: Quick sync — I have a cross-repo change that needs to land in a tight sequence: API -> SDK -> Console -> Helm. Links: redwood/api#983, redwood/sdk#412, redwood/console#210, infra/helm#76. Proposed merge window tomorrow 09:30 PST. Can owners review and either approve or call blockers by EOD today? :eyes:

Maya: Saw the API PR, left a couple small comments on auth header behavior. Nothing blocking, but we should confirm backward compat for clients that don't send the new X-RW-Flags header. Added a test request example.

Jen: I can review SDK later today. Heads up: SDK CI flakes on the windows runner intermittently — if it flakes I'll rerun but prefer someone to land API first so SDK tests run against the updated contract.

Chris: Console depends on the new SDK surface for the sidebar toggle, but we can feature-flag it behind rollout. If SDK lands later we can do a console canary with the flag off by default. I'll queue a patch to remove the integration smoke once SDK stable.

Ryan: Helm chart bump updates the runtime image tag and enables the KV cache toggle. Two notes: 1) helm#76 needs charts version bump and registry creds for the staging repo; 2) runtime team reported one failing e2e that's timing out on seq=4096. Might need a kernel/quantization fallback.

Samir: Thanks — propose this merge order and exact checks: 
1) Merge API (api#983) after Maya + infra owner signoff. Run api integration smoke: `make test-integration-api` and confirm header backward compat.
2) Merge SDK (sdk#412) once API is live in staging, run SDK e2e: `./scripts/e2e_local.sh --api-url=https://staging-api.redwood` (expect ~15m).
3) Merge Console (console#210) with feature-flag off, then enable in canary.
4) Merge Helm (helm#76) as final step to roll runtime with KV cache toggle.

Also: branch protection prevents cross-repo auto-merge until all required CI contexts pass. If anyone can't review in time, please nominate a proxy.

Maya: +1 on the order. I'll approve API once I validate the negative tests. ETA: 16:00 PST.

Jen: If API lands before 18:00 PST I can run SDK e2e overnight and hit approve in morning. If CI flakes, tag me and I'll rerun.

Chris: I'll keep console PR ready. One ask: can we include a small migration note in console changelog about the header toggle so support knows how to triage?

Samir: Good call — added a one-liner in console changelog. Also, Ryan, can you run the runtime e2e with `RUNTIME_QUANT_FALLBACK=1` and post results? If timingouts persist we will pin to previous runtime image for the helm roll.

Ryan: Running now in staging, will post logs. (ci-bot will attach build) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ci-bot: Build 5482 started for infra/helm#76. Logs: https://ci.redwood/build/5482

Ryan: Quick update — the runtime e2e hit the same timeout at seq=4096 but `RUNTIME_QUANT_FALLBACK=1` completed the test successfully. Full logs uploaded: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/5482/runtime-e2e.log

Samir: OK that's actionable. We'll set the helm values to enable quant fallback for the rollout, and add a TODO to revert once kernel fix lands. Ryan, can you make that change in helm#76 and bump chart version?

Ryan: Done — pushed a small commit to infra/helm#76 to set `runtime.quantFallback: true` in staging values and bumped chart to 1.3.5-staging.

Jen: Running SDK e2e now against staging API (api#983 deployed). If we get green I can approve tonight and schedule merge slot for 09:30 PST.

Maya: API negative tests passed, approved.

Jen: SDK e2e passed. Left an approve comment and tagged @Samir for merge.

Samir: Great. Final checklist before merge window: 
- [x] API approved and in staging (Maya)
- [x] SDK e2e green (Jen)
- [x] Console flagged and changelog entry (Chris)
- [x] Helm values set to quantFallback in staging (Ryan)
- [ ] Prod deploy window reservation for 10:00 PST (ops)

Chris: I'll flip console flag in canary after SDK is deployed.

Samir: Can someone from ops/infra confirm a prod deploy window at 10:00 PST tomorrow? If not, propose 11:00 PST as fallback.

deploy-bot: Ops calendar check: available windows — 09:00-10:30 PST (limited), 11:00-13:00 PST (open). Please add the ticket link to reserve slot.

Samir: Reserving 11:00-12:00 PST then. I'll update the rollout doc with rollback instructions and who to page on PagerDuty.

Maya: Thx — will monitor staging and keep an eye on error budgets tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

Jen: If anything flakes after merge ping me and I'll run a quick rollback for SDK via tag.

Chris: I'll prepare a small canary dashboard and add a note in the channel to watch console errors for the first 30m post-rollout.

Samir: Perfect. If no last-minute blockers I'll proceed with merges in the order we agreed. Thanks everyone. :shipit:

Ryan: One last note — I'm going to tag runtime@ on the helm PR for visibility about kernel fix timeline.

Samir: Nice. Closing this thread and will post a short post-merge summary in #eng-runtime once done.

(30m later)

ci-bot: infra/helm#76 CI passed and chart published to staging registry as 1.3.5-staging.

Samir: Merge window complete — api, sdk, console merged to main; helm staged. Will follow up with prod rollout notes.
